title: Quản trị chi phí kinh doanh

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of cost and cost management, principles of cost calculation, and methods of cost control.
Analyze and interpret cost data to support business decision-making.
Use cost information to make informed business decisions.
Identify and solve cost-related problems in a business context.
Collaborate effectively in a team setting to manage costs.
Communicate effectively through presentations and group discussions.
Demonstrate leadership skills in managing costs and decision-making processes.
Understand and apply ethical principles in cost management and business decisions.
Develop self-study skills and adapt to different work environments.
